title: Phawar of Reverence to God and Humankind (Akor Blei Akor Briew)
cultural_context: The culminating philosophical phawar of 'Ka Jingsneng Tymmen' summarizing the totality of Khasi religious ethics: reverence toward God above and justice toward all human beings.

khasi: Mane ia U Blei Nongbuh Nongthaw,
Da ka dohnud kaba sotti bad ba khuid;
U long Uba iohi ia man ka lynti,
Uba donbor ha suiñ bad ha khyndew;
Burom ia u briew uba Me ia shem,
Wat niewpoh ia uba duk ba rangli;
Dei kane ka akor ba u Blei u kwah,
Ban pynim ia ka pyrthei baroh.
english: Worship God, the Supreme Creator and Architect,
With an inner heart that is honest, righteous, and pure;
He is the Omniscient One who observes every path,
Almighty in the heavens and upon the earth;
Respect every fellow human being you encounter,
Never despise the poor or the destitute;
This is the supreme conduct that God desires,
To sustain and preserve the whole human world.

khasi: Kamai ia ka hok ha man ka sngi,
Wat thwet ia ka spah ba pait dohnud;
Ka hok kan neh kum u mawsiang,
Haba ka pyrthei baroh ka la wai;
Ko khun u Hynniewtrep to bat skhem,
Ia kane ka jingsneng ba kyntang;
Ba ka nam jong pha kan sah junom
Ha ka khet jong U Blei ba khraw.
english: Earn your living through righteousness each day,
Pursue no ill-gotten wealth that corrupts the soul;
For righteousness shall stand firm like solid granite,
When all the transient world has passed away;
O children of the Seven Huts, hold steadfast,
To this sacred, timeless ancestral counsel;
So that your honorable name may endure forever
Before the eternal throne of Almighty God.
